title: publish signed metadata and revocation snapshot projection for the current payload candidate

criteria: RC7 signed metadata and revocation projection is generated from RC6 hosted payload metadata and public production signing revocation metadata.
The hosted mirror publishes signatures.json, signed-metadata.json, revocations.json, payload index, install bootstrap, and channel index with matching local hash bindings.

The projection keeps cryptographic_signature_present=false, signature_available=false, install_allowed=false, activation_allowed=false, rollback_execution_allowed=false, production_ready_claim=false, and mirror signing authority false.

The publication verifies live endpoints with curl --resolve, confirms write methods and directory listing remain blocked, and scans outputs for private key paths, private PEM markers, tokens, and raw public fingerprint.
The next task is RC7-003 installer compatibility and rollback baseline publication contract.
